questions.prompt: PHP'da class, interface va trait qanday farqlanadi?

options.text: Class — holat + xatti-harakat, bitta klassdan meros; interface — kontrakt (metod imzolari, konstantalar), ko'p implement; trait — kodni qayta ishlatish (metod va property'lar) ko'p meros o'rniga, `use` bilan klassga qo'shiladi, instansiya qilinmaydi

options.hint: Trait implementatsiya saqlaydi, interface — faqat imzolar.
Yo'q — trait va interface uning o'rnini bosadi.
PHP interface'da tana yo'q (default metod yo'q); trait'da bor.

questions.explanation: Trait konflikt: ikki trait bir xil metod — `use A, B { A::foo insteadof B; B::foo as barFoo; }`. Trait abstract metod talab qilishi mumkin. Laravel: `HasFactory`, `SoftDeletes`, `Notifiable` — trait'lar. Haddan ortiq trait — yashirin bog'liqlik, kompozitsiya afzal.

questions.prompt: Namespace va Composer autoload (PSR-4) qanday ishlaydi?

options.text: Namespace — klass nomlari to'qnashuvini oldini oladi (`App\Services\UserService`); PSR-4 — namespace prefiksi → katalog mapping (`"App\\": "app/"`), klass fayl yo'li namespace'dan hisoblanadi; `vendor/autoload.php` klassni birinchi ishlatilganda yuklaydi (`spl_autoload_register`)

options.hint: Autoload buni yo'q qiladi.

options.text: Namespace — papka nomi, boshqa ma'nosi yo'q
options.hint: Mantiqiy nom; PSR-4 uni papkaga bog'laydi — konvensiya.
Paket + autoload + skriptlar.

questions.explanation: `composer dump-autoload -o` — classmap optimizatsiya (production). `composer.lock` — aniq versiyalar, git'ga kiradi; `composer install` lock'dan, `update` — yangilaydi. Semver cheklovlar `^8.0`. `composer require --dev` — faqat ishlab chiqish. `composer audit` — zaifliklar.

questions.code:
<?php
abstract class Shape {
    abstract public function area(): float;
    public function describe(): string {
        return static::class . ': ' . $this->area();
    }
}
class Square extends Shape {
    public function __construct(private float $side) {}
    public function area(): float { return $this->side ** 2; }
}

echo (new Square(3))->describe();

options.hint: `static::class` — late static binding, chaqirilgan (haqiqiy) klass nomi; `self::class` bo'lsa `Shape` bo'lardi.
`Square` konkret — `area` implement qilingan; `new Shape` bo'lsa xato bo'lardi.
`**` — daraja: 3² = 9.

questions.explanation: `self` — e'lon qilingan klass (compile-time), `static` — runtime klass (late static binding), `parent` — ota. `static` — fluent/factory metodlarda (`return new static()`). Constructor promotion `private float $side` — property e'lon + tayinlash.

questions.prompt: PHP'da magic metodlar (`__get`, `__set`, `__call`, `__toString`) nima va qanday ehtiyotkorlik kerak?

options.text: Mavjud bo'lmagan property/metodga murojaatni ushlash (`__get`/`__set`/`__call`/`__callStatic`), satrga o'girish (`__toString`), `__invoke` — ob'ektni funksiya kabi; kuchli (Eloquent atributlari shunday), lekin IDE/statik tahlil ko'rmaydi, yashirin xatti-harakat — kam ishlatish, `@property` PHPDoc bilan hujjatlash

options.hint: Ular ham magic, lekin ro'yxat uzun.
Bor va keng ishlatiladi (Eloquent, Facade).
Qisqa, lekin "sehrli" — debug va autocomplete qiyin.

questions.explanation: Eloquent `$user->name` — `__get` orqali `attributes` massividan; Facade `Cache::get()` — `__callStatic` orqali container'dagi instansiya. `__toString` — `Stringable` interfeysi (8.0 avtomatik). `__serialize`/`__unserialize`, `__clone`. Laravel IDE Helper — magic uchun PHPDoc generatsiya.

questions.prompt: `composer.json` va `composer.lock` qanday farqlanadi, qaysi biri git'ga kiradi?

options.text: `composer.json` — talablar (versiya diapazoni `^10.0`), skriptlar, autoload; `composer.lock` — `install`/`update` natijasida o'rnatilgan aniq versiyalar va hash'lar; ikkalasi git'da (ilova uchun) — jamoa va production bir xil versiya oladi; kutubxona uchun lock odatda ignore

options.hint: Ilovada lock git'da — aks holda har deploy boshqa versiya.
Biri diapazon, ikkinchisi aniq versiya.
Qo'lda ham, `composer require` ham o'zgartiradi.

questions.explanation: CI/production: `composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction` — lock'dan, dev paketlarsiz. `composer update vendor/package` — bitta paketni yangilash. Dependabot/Renovate — lock'ni avtomatik yangilash PR'lari. `composer outdated` — eskirganlar.

questions.prompt: PHP'da interface + abstract class + trait birgalikda qanday dizayn beradi va qachon qaysi biri?

options.text: Interface — tashqi kontrakt (DI, test uchun almashtirish, type hint); abstract class — umumiy ildiz + Template Method (qisman implementatsiya, konstruktor); trait — gorizontal qayta ishlatish ierarxiyasiz (logging, timestamps). Default — interface + kompozitsiya; abstract — aniq "is-a" ierarxiya; trait — kichik, holatsiz yordamchilar

options.hint: Bitta meros — kengayish cheklanadi; interface moslashuvchan.
Trait — yashirin bog'liqlik, test qiyin; haddan oshsa "trait soup".

options.text: Interface kerak emas — duck typing bor
options.hint: PHP'da type hint interface orqali — kompilyator/PHPStan tekshiradi.

questions.explanation: Laravel misoli: `Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Repository` (interface) → `CacheManager` → driver'lar; `Model` — abstract-ish ildiz; `SoftDeletes` — trait. Trait'da `abstract` metod — klassdan nimani kutishini aniq aytish. Trait'da konstruktor — qochish.

questions.code:
<?php
class OrderService {
    public function process($order) {
        $db = new PDO(getenv('DSN'));
        $mailer = new Mailer(getenv('SMTP'));
        $db->exec("UPDATE orders SET status='paid' WHERE id={$order->id}");
        $mailer->send($order->email, 'Paid');
        Logger::log('processed ' . $order->id);
    }
}

options.text: Bog'liqliklar ichida yaratiladi (`new PDO`, `new Mailer`) — test va almashtirish imkonsiz, konstruktor orqali inject qilish kerak; SQL injection (`{$order->id}` interpolatsiya) — prepared statement; tur e'lonlari yo'q; static `Logger::log` — yashirin bog'liqlik; `getenv` servis ichida — config qatlami

options.hint: Nom qabul qilinadi; tuzilma muammosi.
Drayver tanlovi muammo emas; yaratish joyi muammo.
Bu klassni DB'siz unit test qilib bo'ladimi?

questions.explanation: Yaxshi: `public function __construct(private OrderRepository $orders, private MailerInterface $mailer, private LoggerInterface $logger) {}` — Laravel container avtomatik yig'adi. PSR-3 `LoggerInterface`. Order'ni DTO/Model turi bilan. Bu SOLID'ning D (DIP) va S (SRP) — eng ko'p so'raladigan PHP suhbat savoli.

questions.prompt: PSR standartlari nima va qaysilari muhim?

options.text: PHP-FIG interop standartlari: PSR-4 (autoload), PSR-12 (kod uslubi), PSR-3 (Logger interface), PSR-7/15/17 (HTTP message, middleware, factory), PSR-11 (Container), PSR-6/16 (Cache), PSR-14 (Event dispatcher), PSR-18 (HTTP client) — kutubxonalar framework'dan mustaqil almashinadi

options.hint: Til qoidasi emas — jamoatchilik interop standartlari.
Framework'dan mustaqil — Symfony, Laravel, Slim hammasi qo'llaydi.
Har zamonaviy paket PSR-4, PSR-3, PSR-7/18 ga tayanadi.

questions.explanation: Misol: Monolog PSR-3 implement qiladi — Laravel ham, Symfony ham ishlatadi. Guzzle PSR-7/18. Laravel o'z HTTP abstraksiyasini ishlatadi (Symfony HttpFoundation), lekin PSR-7 ga ko'prik bor. Suhbatda: "PSR-4 va PSR-12 ni bilasizmi" — minimal kutish.

questions.prompt: PHP 8 attributes nima va qayerda ishlatiladi?

options.text: Kodga strukturali metadata (`#[Route('/users')]`, `#[ORM\Column]`) — PHPDoc annotatsiya o'rniga, tilning qismi, reflection orqali o'qiladi (`getAttributes()`); Symfony route/validation, Doctrine mapping, Laravel (8.x+ ba'zi joylar, 11 da ko'proq), PHPUnit `#[Test]`, `#[Override]` (8.3), `#[Deprecated]` (8.4)

options.hint: Property emas — metadata deklaratsiya.
Passiv — faqat o'qiladi, framework unga qarab ish qiladi.
PHPDoc'dan farqi — til tekshiradi, reflection beradi.

questions.explanation: O'z attribute: `#[Attribute(Attribute::TARGET_METHOD)] class Cacheable { public function __construct(public int $ttl) {} }` → `$method->getAttributes(Cacheable::class)[0]->newInstance()`. Attribute vs interface: metadata — attribute, xatti-harakat — interface. Reflection narxi — cache qilish.

questions.prompt: PHP'da immutable value object qanday to'g'ri yoziladi?

options.text: `final readonly class` (8.2+), constructor promotion, konstruktorda validatsiya (invariant), `equals()` metodi, o'zgarish — `with*()` yangi instansiya qaytaradi, named constructor (`fromString`), `__toString`/`Stringable`; massiv property — ichi ham immutable (readonly massivga yozib bo'lmaydi); mutable ob'ekt property'dan qochish

options.hint: Getter mutable ob'ekt qaytarsa — ichi o'zgaradi; `readonly` tilni jalb qiladi.
`readonly` (8.1/8.2) aynan shuning uchun.
`const` — klass darajasi, instansiya qiymati emas.

questions.explanation: `final readonly class Email { public function __construct(public string $value) { if (!filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) throw new InvalidArgumentException(); } }` — noto'g'ri Email mavjud bo'lolmaydi. Eloquent cast (`CastsAttributes`) bilan DB'dan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri VO. PHP 8.3 `clone` ichida readonly qayta init — `with` metodlar uchun.

questions.code:
<?php
trait Counter {
    private static int $count = 0;
    public static function inc(): int { return ++self::$count; }
}
class A { use Counter; }
class B { use Counter; }

A::inc(); A::inc();
B::inc();
echo A::inc(), ' ', B::inc();

options.hint: Trait kodi har ishlatuvchi klassga nusxalanadi — `A` va `B` alohida `$count`ga ega.
`B::inc()` bir marta oldin chaqirilgan — ikkinchisi 2.
Trait'da static property ruxsat etilgan (8.1+ ham).

questions.explanation: Trait — "compiler-assisted copy-paste": har klassga alohida nusxa, static ham. Meros (`B extends A`) bo'lsa — ota klassning property'si baham ko'rilardi (`self::` vs `static::` farqi). Bu trait vs meros semantikasini tekshiradigan savol.

questions.prompt: Katta PHP loyihasida Composer bog'liqliklarini boshqarish strategiyasi qanday bo'lishi kerak?

options.text: Lock git'da, `composer audit` CI'da, Dependabot/Renovate avtomatik PR, semver cheklovlar (`^`), katta major yangilashlar Rector bilan, `composer why`/`why-not` tahlil, private paketlar — Satis/Private Packagist, monorepo bo'lsa path repository, `platform` konfiguratsiya (PHP versiyasi qotiriladi), `--prefer-dist`, kam bog'liqlik (har paket — xavf va yuklash vaqti), abandoned paketlarni kuzatish

options.hint: Nazoratsiz yangilanish — production'da kutilmagan buzilish.
Repo shishadi, yangilash qiyin; lock + install yetarli (ba'zi deploy strategiyalarida vendor artefakt sifatida).
Supply chain hujumlar (packagist typosquatting, hijack) — real.

questions.explanation: Laravel major yangilash — Laravel Shift (avtomatik) yoki Rector set'lar. PHP versiya yangilash — `composer config platform.php 8.3` bilan lokal muhit farqidan qochish. `composer.json`da `"config": {"sort-packages": true}`. Abandoned paket — alternativa qidirish yoki fork.
